title: Translated Launches Lara 3, Making the Case for Specialized Translation AI
key_facts: Translated made Lara 3 generally available on 7 Oct 2026 through the Lara API, TranslationOS and Lara Translate.
Lara 3 followed an introduction to selected partners in July.
In Translated's blind evaluations, professional translators rated 82 percent of Lara 3's translations as perfect, requiring no edits.
The evaluation covered 16,800 English translations into 21 enterprise localisation languages; Lara finished first in 20 of 21 pairs.
The release reports speed and cost benchmarks separately from quality results.
Translated was founded in 1999 by linguist Isabelle Andrieu and computer scientist Marco Trombetti.
quote_evidence: in Translated’s blind evaluations, professional translators rated 82% of Lara 3’s translations as perfect, requiring no edits.
The release says Lara finished first in 20 of the 21 language pairs.
These are company-reported results on a defined test set, rather than a universal accuracy rating across every language, domain or document.
why_it_matters_hint: Businesses translating at scale may need fewer edits, if the company's test results hold for their own material.
notes: Read from Unite.AI (6,883 chars). The Unite.AI byline names an AI-generated research agent reviewed by its editors. Quality results are the company's, on its own test set.
